plan.title: Aldosterone vs vehicle kidney: DE + TF activity (top 6)
plan.analytical_narrative: The data context gives 6 aldosterone-treated vs 6 vehicle-control human kidney samples, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples). The research question asks specifically which transcription factors drive the treated-vs-control response, ranked to the top 6 per direction. Following the grounded procedure from the knowledge service (DESeq2 two-group workflow, tpl-deseq2-two-group + tpl-decoupler-tf-activity): (1) QC the sample structure with a blind VST/PCA/distance heatmap to confirm the 6v6 grouping and rule out an outlier or a hidden batch before any test runs; (2) import via tximport-style gene-level counts (already gene-summed per the profile) and fit DESeq2 with an explicit reference level (control) and a minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group), Wald test, apeglm shrinkage, BH-adjusted results at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering; (3) infer TF activity with decoupleR's ulm on the CollecTRI human regulon using the DESeq2 Wald statistic of every tested gene (not just the significant subset), which is the grounded default for a 6-vs-6 fixed design too small for network inference from the data itself (R-0121: prior-knowledge network only); (4) as a robustness complement and because the question asks for a definitive top-6 ranked list, also run decoupleR ulm on the DoRothEA confidence A-C regulons and report the overlap between CollecTRI- and DoRothEA-based top hits; (5) run Hallmark GSEA on the same Wald-statistic ranking as pathway-level context for the TF calls (not the primary answer, but grounds the mechanistic interpretation); (6) synthesize a report that names the top 6 activated and top 6 repressed (or top 6 by absolute activity, stated explicitly) transcription factors with their activity scores, regulon sizes, supporting DE genes (leading-edge/target overlap), and all required reproducibility/versioning fields. All steps operate on the actual condition labels (aldosterone-treated vs vehicle-control) and the actual 12-sample, 12000-gene matrix; no invented dataset facts.

steps.method: Keep genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples (smallest group size)
DESeq2 design ~condition, explicit reference level = vehicle/control
decoupleR univariate linear model (ulm) on CollecTRI regulons using the DESeq2 Wald statistic of all tested genes
